version.description: The version of the project, semver (1.2.3, with an optional pre-release).

entrypoint.description: The file loading starts from. Default: src/main.bs

api_level.description: The Blossom API version required, MAJOR.MINOR. Leaving it out means 1.0, which this runtime no longer accepts: the current level is 2.0.

autoload.description: When true the pack loads by itself as soon as the world is open, without /blossom script load. Default: false.

dependencies.description: The dependencies of the project: path, pack or registry, one form per dependency.

path.description: A folder, usually next to the project. It is not pinned in the lock file.

watchdog.description: The execution limits of the app. false removes them entirely.

timeout_ms.description: The maximum time of one execution, in milliseconds. Default: 2000 in events, 15000 in commands.
